description: Branded packaged food and pet food maker (Cheerios, Pillsbury, Blue Buffalo, Häagen-Dazs).

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-09-23 (Wednesday, before the open), 4 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 0.72.
catalyst.why: The 2026-09-23 report must show North America Retail volumes still falling and pet sales slowing, forcing a guidance cut.

reasons: GLP-1 [weight-loss drugs] use is forecast to roughly double over the next decade, and users eat less high-fat, sugary, ultra-processed food—exactly GIS's snacks, cereal, and baking mix.
Private label store brands are gaining share as food prices stay high, pressuring GIS's branded packaged food sales and shelf space.
Cat households grew 4.1% while dog households fell 4.2% from 2019 to 2025, leaving GIS's dog-heavy Blue Buffalo portfolio misaligned with pet ownership.

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-12-23 report, with the long leg expiring 2027-01-15, which gives the deterioration time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The credit ratio clears the floor, but the short put expiring in four weeks carries gap risk around earnings. The 20:6 ratio means the long put position is the main exposure; if the stock spikes on a beat, the short puts lose but the long puts retain value. Size is moderate.
